# Interdot — B2B Technology Advisory & Vendor Matchmaking

> Interdot (FIX FIGURES LLC) connects growing companies with the right technology partners—based on what is happening in their business right now.
> We monitor business-change signals, identify likely technology needs, evaluate relevant vendors, and facilitate qualified introductions.
> We are a consulting practice — not a SaaS product.
